selection: all saved calibration models of all 18 new campaigns; explicit structural absences; no performance/outcome selection
method_order: rotate Cartesian method-major (method,representation) list left by (case_index+round) modulo 16; cases lexicographic
output_contract: six variants and five contrasts, exact endpoint fractions and statuses; no witness output for any timed backend
reuse: one current backend per stream; persistent CUDD manager, aGrUM BayesNet container, Storm Environment and property cache; rebuild predicate-dependent data when exact key changes; no final-answer or category-extrema memoization
reuse_key: all fields determining predicates and coordinate correspondence, excluding frequencies, masks and nonsemantic metadata
updates: declared artificial transformations of saved models; no new observations or independent campaigns
construction_boundary: loaded original model through common input projection, exact semantic-key check, optional construction and endpoint query; imports excluded; conversion separately reported and included in total
stage_costs: common projection, key check, construction, backend data update, query excluding update, wall and CPU; diagnostic reads after timers
memory_scope: GNU time peak RSS across fresh seven-snapshot process including imports, load and diagnostics; verification oracle is a different parent process
bayesian_intervals: proved full-support Boolean oracle with LazyPropagation; uniform missing bits only in the auxiliary support law, never imputed target probabilities; not a generic native credal-network algorithm
bayesian_arithmetic: native double exact-inference algorithm; inspect each posterior cell for exact zero/positive; no unconditional verification inference; rational frequency aggregation; posterior cell validation after timed streams
markov_intervals: exact-rational finite DTMC when no nondeterministic choices; otherwise MDP Pmin/Pmax reachability; no invented continuous-time rates
markov_compression: sparse: existing completion-prefix decision graph; compact: exact terminal-label/transition equivalence and deterministic unlabelled stutter elimination, initial state retained for frequency updates; not native double bisimulation
scope: computation on fixed joint empirical models; independent identification accuracy and full telemetry reconstruction are separate experiments
verification: source integrity in parent; native toy controls in exited process; final exact qualification after all profile streams; no oracle references in timed workers
structure_update: add an actual synchronous edge from entry to first distinct required service (self if none), no factors or new signals; preserve reusable library infrastructure; restore original at final snapshot
failure_policy: preserve failed row and skip later snapshots of the same broken stream as upstream_failure; timeout kills entire process; never silently recreate infrastructure after failure
cudd_config: fixed initial cache 16384, memory_estimate 1GiB; control coordinates before completion coordinates; fixed or one explicit sift per semantic build; retain manager on rebuild
agrum_config: uniform positive observation-category support prior; conditioned LazyPropagation versus all (category,unique output) joint targets; no extra mixture query; retain BN container; rebuild engine after CPT/mask changes; counts only update exact outer weights
selection_policy: all fixed variants retained; no per-case winner selection; no timing-driven tuning after measurement
